entities.summary: George Charles of Hesse-Darmstadt was a German prince of the House of Hesse-Darmstadt. He was the fourth child and third son of Prince George William of Hesse-Darmstadt and his wife, Countess Maria Louise Albertine of Leiningen-Dagsburg-Falkenburg. He never married, and had no children.
